semantic_contract.task_statement: Convert numerical scores into grade categories (Pass, Merit, Distinction).

result.canonical_semantics: Grade category according to the frozen task thresholds: <60 FAIL, 60-<70 PASS, 70-<80 MERIT, >=80 DISTINCTION.

semantic_contract.human_review_instruction: Judge the original generated pseudocode against this same frozen task-semantic contract, including when automated evaluation is NOT_EVALUABLE.

declared_evidence_summary: This suite exercises the valid score range at 0, 59.9, 60, 70, 80 and 100 plus interaction-only non-numeric evidence. Scores below 0 and above 100 are evaluated separately as semantic-boundary probes.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on 7 core Common Test cases plus any separately declared semantic-boundary probes; boundary probes do not contribute to core behavioural accuracy.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret core behavioural accuracy as evidence within the frozen semantic contract. Interpret Semantic Boundary Variance separately as descriptive evidence of out-of-domain acceptance.
coverage_limitations: Scores below 0 and above 100 are outside NUMBER_0_TO_100 and are reported separately through semantic-boundary variance.
